meta.description: Checks that the authorship class recorded in an AIIR commit receipt is one of the classes allowed by the `allowedAuthorshipClasses` context value, a pipe-separated list. A project can, for example, admit human-authored and AI-assisted commits while rejecting fully AI-authored ones.
meta.name: Allowed Authorship Classes

allowedAuthorshipClasses.description: Pipe-separated list of allowed AIIR authorship_class values

error.message: AIIR authorship class is not allowed
error.guidance: AuthorshipClass {{ .Outputs.authorshipClass }} is not allowed for revisions in this repo
